# Tower facade textures

Generated by `node scripts/make-facades.mjs` (PNG via zlib, then macOS `sips` to JPEG q88). Original work, CC0 1.0, no third-party content.

| File | Size | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| glass-blue-color.jpg / -rough.jpg | 512x512 | blue curtain wall, 2 lites per bay, dark spandrels (tile 12 m x 14.4 m) |
| glass-teal-color.jpg / -rough.jpg | 512x512 | teal / graphite curtain wall with heavy fins |
| concrete-warm-color.jpg / -rough.jpg | 512x512 | warm concrete spandrels with ribbon windows |
| stone-cream-color.jpg / -rough.jpg | 512x512 | cream stone with punched, framed windows |
| storefront-color.jpg / -rough.jpg / -emissive.jpg | 640x384 | lit double-height ground floor (tile 12 m x 7.2 m) |

Total about 560 KB. The roughness maps make glass smooth and stone/concrete rough; the emissive map lights the storefront ceiling spots and signage strips.

## Licence research (2026-10-23)
- ambientCG, Facade 001 (https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Facade001): CC0 1.0, 1K JPG about 3 MB, 2K about 5 MB, 4K about 12 MB; licence https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/ (attribution optional, game redistribution allowed). Reviewed, not shipped: one fixed photo-like tile would repeat identically on every tower and its scale does not match our 3.6 m floors.
- Poly Haven facade category page returned 404, nothing used.
- Kenney City Kit (Commercial) skyscraper GLBs (CC0, already in assets/) are not loaded by any map: game.js only loads building-a..n, so the vertex-colour skyscrapers never rendered. Tall buildings were Tiko's photo-textured towers (CC BY 4.0, la-real/la-tower-source.json), which are unchanged and still part of the tower pool.
